content.text:
I couldn't get any of this data, so I have nothing to report for the five vendors. I won't give you entity numbers or dates from memory, because you asked for official SOS data only and a wrong number in a vendor file would be worse than a gap.

The California Secretary of State's business search (bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov) sits behind Incapsula bot protection. My requests to it, one per vendor, all returned a bot-challenge page instead of results. Getting past that would mean circumventing the site's access controls, so I stopped. I also didn't fall back to OpenCorporates or similar aggregators, since you wanted official data only.

You can pull the data yourself in a few minutes:
1. Go to https://bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov/search/business.
2. Search each name. Try a shorter string such as "Notion Labs" or "Rippling", because punctuation and "Inc." variants affect matching.
3. Open the matching record and use the "Statement of Information" and "Initial Filing Date" fields.

One thing to check as you go. Several of these companies are Delaware corporations (I believe Anthropic PBC is too, but I haven't confirmed any of them). A Delaware company doing business in California should appear as a foreign registration. If a vendor only shows up as a different or older name, or not at all, that is the thing you wanted to find out before signing.

For each record, capture:
- Entity number
- Status
- Initial filing date
- State of formation (listed as "Jurisdiction")
- Agent for service of process

If you paste the record text or screenshots here, I'll put them into a comparison table and flag problems such as suspended or forfeited status, a name mismatch with your contract party, or an agent that has resigned. For certified proof, the SOS also sells certificates of status, and a Certificate of Good Standing is a common ask for vendor onboarding.
